text.p: French first division side Lens, who are one place above the relegation zone, have sacked coach Slavo Muslin because of poor results, club president Gervais Martel said on Monday.
Martel appointed Roger Lemerre, a former Lens player and coach who guided them to promotion in 1981, in Muslin's place.
Yugoslav-born Muslin took charge of Lens in the off-season after being sacked by Bordeaux in the middle of last season.
Lens, who were top after winning the first four matches of the league season, have won only four more out of the 24 since then and have won only once this year.
